'''2000 DecipherCon Reflections Booster Draft (6 October)''' was a Star Wars CCG side event (booster draft) held in Kissimmee, Florida on 6 October 2000. It is known from Andy Klema's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1356">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-16-rexbanner-goes-to-d-cond1356/ rexbanner-goes-to-d-con], DeckTech (Andy "RexBanner7" Klema, 16 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-16-rexbanner-goes-to-d-cond1356/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[DecipherCon 2000]].

* '''Date:''' 6 October 2000
* '''Site:''' Kissimmee, Florida
* '''Format:''' [[Reflections Booster Draft]]
